_about: The token tree build_tokens.py turns into tokens.json. enode.com declares its design-token layer in the inline app-css bundle (raw/css-vars.json): theme-invariant scales under core.* and a [data-mode]-switching semantic layer emitted under both light.* and dark.* so each scope resolves its own value. Measured roles alias to the declared values where they match.
